usInbound.label: US inbound services — WHT + PE risk
usInbound.question: A foreign parent provides management services to a US subsidiary. What are the key US federal tax risks (WHT, PE/ECI, transfer pricing documentation), and what facts change the conclusion?
usInbound.fact1: • Foreign parent has no US entity; services delivered remotely + occasional US travel
usInbound.fact3: • Contract governs services; no US employees on US payroll
usInbound.fact4: • Need: ECI/PE indicators, Form W-8/W-9 positions, TP support outline

brazilImports.label: Brazil imports — ICMS/PIS/COFINS stack (triage)
brazilImports.question: Importing equipment into Brazil for resale: outline the main taxes (II, IPI, PIS/COFINS-Import, ICMS) and the top levers (NCM, ex-tarifário, special regimes). Keep it conservative and list missing facts.
brazilImports.fact1: • Importer is a Brazilian CNPJ under Lucro Real
brazilImports.fact4: • CIF known; goal is to estimate landed cost range + missing facts list

latamHolding.label: LATAM holding — source rules triage
latamHolding.question: A Panama company invoices foreign clients for consulting services. Is it Panama-source income? Any local corporate tax exposure, substance concerns, or foreign withholding risk (treaty / domestic law)?
latamHolding.fact1: • Services performed by employees located outside Panama
latamHolding.fact2: • Panama entity has director + bank account; minimal local ops
latamHolding.fact4: • Need: where services performed, contract terms, withholding regimes by client country

howItWorks.title: How TaxAiPro Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Multi-model AI analysis designed for tax professionals.
howItWorks.intro1: TaxAiPro is a professional analysis tool designed to help tax practitioners evaluate complex tax questions using a multi-model AI cross-analysis workflow.
howItWorks.intro2: Instead of relying on a single artificial intelligence system, TaxAiPro sends a user’s question to several leading AI models simultaneously, compares their responses, and generates a conservative synthesized output.
howItWorks.intro3: The goal is not to replace professional judgment, but to help practitioners identify assumptions, surface missing facts, and detect areas of uncertainty faster.
howItWorks.intro4: Importantly, TaxAiPro is not its own Large Language Model. The platform does not train or operate proprietary AI. Instead, it acts as an analysis and orchestration layer that compares outputs from multiple external AI systems.
howItWorks.guideCardBody: Prefer a visual overview? Open the short guide video for a quick walkthrough of the TaxAiPro workflow and user experience.

cards.why1: Single AI systems can omit caveats or express excessive confidence.
cards.why2: Different models may interpret the same facts differently.
cards.why3: Running multiple systems creates a broader analytical perspective.
cards.why4: Agreement between models may increase confidence.
cards.why5: Disagreement highlights areas requiring professional review.
cards.workflow1: Select the jurisdiction relevant to the tax question.
cards.workflow2: Describe the facts including entities, timing, and transaction structure.
cards.workflow3: Enter the specific tax question to be analyzed.
cards.workflow4: Run analysis, which triggers multiple AI systems simultaneously.
cards.workflow5: Review the synthesized output highlighting assumptions and caveats.
cards.parallelBody1: TaxAiPro sends the prompt to multiple external AI providers. Each system independently generates an interpretation of the issue.
cards.parallelBody2: TaxAiPro does not modify these answers initially. The responses are collected and prepared for cross-model comparison.
cards.comparison4: Surface missing facts referenced by individual systems.
cards.comparison5: Evaluate the consistency of reasoning across outputs.
cards.comparisonBody: This comparison transforms several independent answers into a structured analytical view of the issue.
cards.consensusBody: After analyzing the model responses, TaxAiPro produces a conservative synthesized draft.
cards.consensus4: Missing facts that may change the conclusion
cards.consensus6: Confidence indicator based on cross-model alignment
cards.tools1: Export results as memo drafts or email summaries.
cards.tools4: Run follow-up analysis with additional facts.
cards.misunderstanding1: Some users assume that TaxAiPro is a proprietary artificial intelligence model.
cards.misunderstanding2: In reality, TaxAiPro does not train its own AI system and does not “learn” from user questions in the way traditional machine learning models do.
cards.misunderstanding3: Instead, the platform functions as a multi-model analysis and synthesis engine that compares outputs from several external AI systems.
cards.misunderstanding4: Users are paying for structured cross-checking, conservative synthesis, and workflow tools designed specifically for tax professionals.

howItWorks.footerDisclaimer: TaxAiPro is a decision-support tool and does not provide legal or tax advice. Always validate outputs using primary sources and professional judgment.
